description: Methylxanthine purine-2,6-dione: primary π→π* absorption at 273 nm (ε 9750 in 0.01M HCl). Caffeine is effectively non-ionisable at physiological pH (pKa >13).
clinicalNote: USP UV-Vis linearity and system suitability standard. Assayed at 273 nm in 0.01M HCl. Standard component in paracetamol/caffeine tablet HPLC system suitability testing.

sources.citation: United States Pharmacopeia USP 41, Caffeine Monograph. UV assay at 273 nm; ε = 9750 L·mol⁻¹·cm⁻¹ in 0.01M HCl.
